items.title: Kash Patel says that AI use at the FBI has 'increased by 605%' since he became director — claims that every major tech player is 'embedded' in the agency
items.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel stated in an interview that he's responsible for a "605% increase" in the bureau's usage of AI. The problem is that it's hard to pin down what the figure refers to.
items.title_original: Kash Patel says that AI use at the FBI has 'increased by 605%' since he became director — claims that every major tech player is 'embedded' in the agency
items.title_en: Kash Patel says that AI use at the FBI has 'increased by 605%' since he became director — claims that every major tech player is 'embedded' in the agency
items.title_bilingual: Kash Patel says that AI use at the FBI has 'increased by 605%' since he became director — claims that every major tech player is 'embedded' in the agency
items.summary_zh: FBI 局长卡什·帕特尔 (Kash Patel) 在接受采访时表示，他对联邦调查局人工智能的使用量“增加了 605%”负有责任。问题是很难确定这个数字指的是什么。

items.title: Autonomous strike drone uses Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano to independently pick and bomb targets — Swedish startup's attack drones run small AI model, require no human input and zero external comms
items.summary: Drones built with small, non-frontier computer-vision models autonomously identified and attacked targets in a recent demo.

items.title: Jensen Huang says there is '0% chance' AI destroys the world by 2030 — 'We should go as fast as we can, irrespective of anyone else,' dismisses Anthropic doom warnings and rejects new regulations
items.summary: Chief executive of Nvidia claims that fears that AI will destroy humanity in the coming years are unsubstantiated as safety mechanisms can preserve that.
items.title_original: Jensen Huang says there is '0% chance' AI destroys the world by 2030 — 'We should go as fast as we can, irrespective of anyone else,' dismisses Anthropic doom warnings and rejects new regulations

items.title_bilingual: Jensen Huang says there is '0% chance' AI destroys the world by 2030 — 'We should go as fast as we can, irrespective of anyone else,' dismisses Anthropic doom warnings and rejects new regulations
items.summary_zh: 英伟达首席执行官声称，对人工智能将在未来几年毁灭人类的担忧是没有根据的，因为安全机制可以保护这一点。

items.title: Putin casts online vote using unlicensed Windows on an American Dell PC — 'Activate Windows' watermark visible in official Kremlin clip, uses foreign Dell PC despite Russian tech mandate
items.summary: An official Russian media clip shows Putin voting on a Dell PC with an unlicensed copy of Windows.
items.title_original: Putin casts online vote using unlicensed Windows on an American Dell PC — 'Activate Windows' watermark visible in official Kremlin clip, uses foreign Dell PC despite Russian tech mandate

items.summary_zh: 俄罗斯官方媒体剪辑显示普京在装有未经许可的 Windows 副本的戴尔 PC 上投票。

items.title: Collapse of mainstream optical drive supply kills high-end CD players — PS Audio and Naim halt production as component costs double
items.summary: PS Audio and Naim had to cease production of two Hi-Fi models as manufacturers quit making optical drives, even as CD and vinyl have hit record sales in recent months.
items.title_original: Collapse of mainstream optical drive supply kills high-end CD players — PS Audio and Naim halt production as component costs double
items.title_en: Collapse of mainstream optical drive supply kills high-end CD players — PS Audio and Naim halt production as component costs double
items.title_zh: 主流光驱供应崩溃导致高端 CD 播放器死亡——PS Audio 和 Naim 因组件成本翻倍而停产
items.title_bilingual: 主流光驱供应崩溃导致高端 CD 播放器死亡——PS Audio 和 Naim 因组件成本翻倍而停产 / Collapse of mainstream optical drive supply kills high-end CD players — PS Audio and Naim halt production as component costs double
items.summary_zh: 由于制造商停止生产光驱，PS Audio 和 Naim 不得不停止生产两款 Hi-Fi 型号，尽管近几个月来 CD 和黑胶唱片的销量创下了纪录。
